column1: # Role registry for LM Studio (ADR 0016). Tab-separated. One of the two files
# allowed to name concrete models (the other is docs/MODELS.md).
# model_key is the modelKey from `lms ls --json`, with @variant when a model
# has several quantisations on disk. ctx and slots are per load;
# slots becomes `lms load --parallel` for chat models. Read by scripts/lms-load.sh.
# weights is the path under ~/.lmstudio/models that scripts/pin-digests.sh
# hashes (D4); `lms ls` reports a catalogue key, not the folder on disk.
# draft: mtp → lms load --speculative-draft-mtp; "-" leaves it off.
# Same weights, so the tokens are still the model's. Speeds decode, not prefill.
